event:schemaexpr is carried unevaluated: the expression is never evaluated, so it never raises error.execution.

A <send> through the SCXML Event I/O Processor whose data its own literal event:schema rejects, or, for an event the session delivers to itself (no target, #_internal, or its own session address), a literal event:schema of a transition of the document whose descriptor matches the event, is not dispatched, and error.execution ends its block; so is one to another session (#_parent, #_<invokeid>) whose data a literal event:schema of a transition of the receiving document handling it rejects; a <raise> such a schema rejects (its event has no data) is not raised, and error.execution ends its block. Transition selection and <donedata> are unchanged: no schema is checked when an event is selected or a done event is generated.
